tokens.v: The pair stands on a millimetre of still water over white salt flat at dusk, a perfect mirror doubling them against a sky running peach to violet, the horizon line dissolving so shoes and reflection float in one continuous gradient. 85mm at f/5.6 from ankle height thirty steps back, both derbies razor sharp, their mirrored twins barely softer, concentric ripple rings spreading from the toe of the near shoe where a drop just fell. Salt crust texture reads through the shallows in the near foreground, cut by the bottom corners; the gradient runs out every other edge unbroken.
